Find the amount which when lent on compound interest at 15% interest being compounded annually for 2 years, gives total interest equal to profit earned by Chand in 2023
solution:
**Given:**

Profit earned by Chand in 2023 = ₹ 2580

Compound interest rate = 15% per annum

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = Principal × [(1 + Rate/100)Time - 1]

Where:

Principal = P (to be determined)
